item.title: Whiskers 0.8.28
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.28

### Local Model Reliability

  • Improved local model storage so Whiskers now uses a single stable location and automatically migrates existing model files from legacy paths
  • Reduced model setup friction by moving fully to the active whisper.cpp local stack and validating model files against expected checksums

    • ### Bulk Transcription

  • Improved Bulk Transcription startup so saved files and progress restore cleanly without the brief empty-state flash
  • Improved status clarity during transcription and kept model availability warm while background refreshes run
  • Clarified export behavior by showing how transformed text is used for Copy/TXT and original segments for SRT

    • ### Support & Feedback

  • Added direct in-app feedback submission so you can send issues or suggestions straight to the Whiskers team
  • Improved support form validation with clearer minimum-length guidance and more stable layout while validation hints appear
  • Improved submission feedback with clearer success and error messages for network/server failures

    • ### Improvements

  • Reorganized Settings sections so key pages like Models and Bulk Transcription are easier to find
